simple.summary: בַּצֹּרֶת (batstsôreth) means restraint (of rain), i.e. drought First listed occurrence: Jer 14 1.

definitions.full: H1226. batstsoreth בַּצֹּרֶת noun feminine dearth (compare following), בּ ׳שְׁנַת Jer 17:8 . בַּצָּרָה noun feminine dearth, destitution (i.e. diminution , compare PS 572 ; see also verb ᵑ7 בצר Prov 14:28 people reduced ) — dearth (= בצרת ) בּ ׳עִתּוֺת Psa 9:10 ; 10:1 ; plural בַּצָּרוֺת Jer 14:1 .
